query: MATCH (c:Company {companyName:'Samsung'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c) WITH c,count(DISTINCT t) AS totalTdocs OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t2:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c) WITH totalTdocs,count(DISTINCT t2) AS referencedTdocCount RETURN totalTdocs,referencedTdocCount,CASE WHEN totalTdocs=0 THEN null ELSE round(100.0*referencedTdocCount/totalTdocs,1) END AS contributionRate
